description: This file defines the EmployeeEducationDecorator class which provides additional methods and functionality for the EmployeeEducation entity, including setting relationships and formatting dates.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class providing additional behaviors and helpers for EmployeeEducation entities, including setting employee and education references, and formatting start/end dates.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmployeeEducation entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Protected method to retrieve the associated EmployeeEducation entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity associated with EmployeeEducation by employee number.

methods.name: setEducationByEducationId
methods.description: Sets the Education entity associated with EmployeeEducation by education ID.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the employee's education.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the employee's education.
